 5 more die of dengue, 1,537 hospitalised in a day
 Death toll rises to 507 as total cases reach 1,65,644 
 Published : 17 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 17 November 2026, 19:04
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 At least five dengue patients died and 1,537 others were hospitalised in 24 hours until 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 All five deaths were reported from Dhaka division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the total death toll rose to 507, while the cumulative number of cases reached 1,65,644.
 Currently, 5,609 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
